_Last updated: September 2026._

## Who we are
Saventi is a software engineering company based in Venezuela (service area: Venezuela and remote worldwide) that designs and builds custom software for growing companies: management systems and ERPs, web platforms and SaaS applications, iOS and Android mobile apps, API integrations, legacy system modernization, and cloud architecture consulting.

Differentiating proposition:
- 100% bespoke: every function, screen and database is modeled around your business rules — no templates or off-the-shelf software.
- Full ownership: on completion of each stage and of the project, all copyright, code repositories, database schemas and access are transferred to you, with no dependencies or royalties.
- Confidentiality: a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) is signed before any technical analysis or discovery meeting.
- Warranty & support: post-delivery technical warranty included, plus preventive support and monitoring plans.

## Services
1. Bespoke ERPs and Management Systems: centralize inventory, orders, invoicing, purchasing, HR and operations in a private application tailored to your business flows.
2. Web Platforms and SaaS Applications: fast, scalable web solutions with modern admin dashboards and optimized UX.
3. Mobile Apps (iOS & Android): native and hybrid apps with real-time data sync and push notifications.
4. API Integrations and Automation: connect with payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal, local banks), WhatsApp Business API, CRMs and third-party services.
5. System Modernization and Data Migration: move obsolete or slow software to cloud architectures, improving security, speed and usability.
6. Technical Consulting and Cloud Architecture: architecture design advisory, infrastructure selection (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and cost optimization.

## Technologies
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- Backend: Node.js, Python.
- Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis.
- Cloud & deployment: AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Vercel.
- QA coverage: quality testing, security audits and stress tests before deployment.

## Engagement models (pricing)
1. Turnkey Project: fixed budget, milestone payments. Ideal for new systems, MVPs or digitalizations with a defined scope. Includes technical discovery and UX/UI design, full-stack development, testing and cloud deployment, full code transfer and post-launch warranty.
2. Dedicated Team (Squad): monthly fee, agile sprints with weekly deliveries, direct communication (Slack/Teams), QA and code review, flexibility to scale.
3. Support & Consulting (Hours Package): continuous monitoring and backups, security patches, hours bank for new features, response SLA and infrastructure advisory.

## Process and timelines
- Free technical assessment and closed scope before quoting (no hidden costs).
- Agile sprints with regular functional deliveries.
- MVP or initial system: 4 to 8 weeks.
- ERPs or complex platforms: 8 to 16 weeks, with biweekly functional deliveries.
- Contact response within 24 business hours.

## FAQ (with answers)
1. How long does custom software take? It depends on complexity and scope: an MVP or initial system usually takes 4–8 weeks; advanced ERPs or platforms 8–16 weeks with biweekly deliveries.
2. Do I own the code and IP 100%? Yes: all copyright, repositories, database schemas and access are transferred with no dependencies or royalties.
3. Do you sign NDAs? Yes, before any detailed technical analysis or discovery meeting.
4. What technologies do you use? React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS; Node.js, Python; PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis; deployments on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure or Vercel.
5. Do you offer warranty and support after launch? Yes: post-delivery technical warranty against bugs, plus preventive support, monitoring and ongoing evolution via hours packages.
6. How is cost calculated and paid? Three models: turnkey (fixed budget and milestones), dedicated squad (monthly fee) and support by hours package. A free technical assessment with closed scope is done before quoting.
7. Can you integrate with my current systems? Yes: payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal, local banks), WhatsApp Business API, CRMs, accounting systems and existing ERPs, with synchronization and workflow automation.
